name: healthie-score
notes: Food: clip(round(0.5*NQ + 0.25*ADD + 0.2*PROC + 5*ORG),0,100). Pet: clip(round(0.4*NQ + 0.4*ADD + 0.15*PROC + 5*ORG + proteinBoost),0,100). Cosmetic: min(clip(composition,0,100), hazardCap). Letter/NOVA/risk ceilings are applied in TypeScript after this mix. Load with onnxruntime-web later; the in-app interpreter in src/lib/edge/score-graph.ts is the current executor.
